answer: A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, and hence paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Cosignatures are collected in kernel, verified in garden, and knoll names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 5 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 13 submissions per epoch. Every extra alias adds 3 hours of verification and 22 percent more locked value. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
